Time-Dependent ROC/AUC Curve from a Survival-Probability Matrix

Source: R/evaluation.R
timeroc_survmat.Rd

Computes the cumulative/dynamic time-dependent AUC (Uno et al., 2007; Heagerty and Zheng, 2005) at each time in times, using marginal (Kaplan-Meier) inverse-probability-of-censoring weighting for cases. This is a thin vectorized wrapper around auc_survmat that returns a full \(AUC(t)\) curve instead of a single time point, matching the quantity reported by timeROC::timeROC() with weighting = "marginal".

Usage

timeroc_survmat(object, predicted, times)

Arguments

object

A Surv object of length \(n\).

predicted

An n x k matrix or data frame of survival probabilities with columns named "t=<time>", one column per entry of times.

times

Numeric vector of evaluation time points; each must have a matching "t=<time>" column in predicted.

Value

A data.frame (class "timeroc_survmat") with columns time and auc, one row per entry of times.

References

Uno H, Cai T, Tian L, Wei LJ (2007). Evaluating prediction rules for t-year survivors with censored regression models. doi:10.1198/016214507000000149

Heagerty PJ, Zheng Y (2005). Survival model predictive accuracy and ROC curves. doi:10.1111/j.0006-341X.2005.030814.x

See also

auc_survmat()

Examples

y <- survival::Surv(time = veteran$time, event = veteran$status)
times <- c(30, 90, 180)
sp <- sapply(times, function(t) stats::plogis(-scale(veteran$karno) + log(t) / 5))
colnames(sp) <- paste0("t=", times)
timeroc_survmat(y, predicted = sp, times = times)
#>   time      auc
#> 1   30 0.142451
#> 2   90 0.172116
#> 3  180 0.287582
